Core Active Vocabulary (8 items):

bill — the paper showing what you must pay. Example: Could we have the bill, please?
pay — to give money for something. Example: I pay by card.
card — a plastic card used for payment. Example: Can I pay by card?
cash — coins and notes. Example: I pay in cash.
receipt — the paper proving you paid. Example: Could I have a receipt, please?
supermarket — a large shop selling food. Example: I buy food at the supermarket.
kilo — one thousand grams. Example: A kilo of potatoes, please.
bottle — a container for liquids. Example: A bottle of water, please.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Could we have the bill, please?
• Can I pay by card?
• A kilo of potatoes, please.
• A bottle of water.
• Here is your receipt.
